business_outcome: Remove unnecessary public database authority and guarantee that production provider-token runtime cannot silently fall back to plaintext or legacy reads.

excluded: production migration in this repository-only stage

invariants: Shopify Billing remains E10-T7 authority and is not implemented by this package.
Legacy expire_trials remains callable by service_role until E10-T7 consumer-zero retirement.
Database trigger execution for handle_new_user remains intact while external RPC execution is removed.
No secret, key material, token, URL, project ref or credential value appears in evidence or diagnostics.
Existing required browser SELECT/CRUD grants are not removed without an object-by-object consumer proof.
Production crypto fail-closed enforcement is not activated before a non-secret live posture preflight passes.

phases.output: Read-only ACL inventory, redacted live evidence and non-secret crypto posture evaluator.
Least-privilege migration and postcheck; live application requires separate approval.
Production crypto readiness policy; server startup wiring waits for live preflight.
Live migration, negative role tests, Security Advisor recheck and production runtime acceptance.

default_privileges: revoke future table/sequence privileges from anon and authenticated
revoke future function EXECUTE from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated
function_acl: handle_new_user service_role only for explicit allowlist; trigger remains
required_database_changes.function_search_path: set empty search_path; referenced application relations remain schema-qualified
required_database_changes.legacy_table_privileges: remove only TRUNCATE, TRIGGER and REFERENCES from anon/authenticated on the exact 14-table inventory

default_privilege_control.rule: Project SQL changes only postgres-owned defaults. Supabase's internal supabase_admin defaults remain provider-controlled and are reviewed through Data API settings and the announced platform rollout; the migration must not impersonate or alter that internal role.

trial_preservation.rule: RM-01 must not substitute the legacy subscriptions table for Shopify billing authority.

crypto_acceptance.diagnostic_redaction: names, booleans and safe reason codes only

live_acceptance: anon/authenticated/PUBLIC cannot execute the three enumerated functions
service_role can execute expire_trials without changing its business semantics
14 legacy tables expose no TRUNCATE/TRIGGER/REFERENCES to anon/authenticated
future postgres-owned public object defaults are explicit least privilege; supabase_admin remains provider-controlled
Supabase Security Advisor function/default privilege findings close or are explicitly classified
production crypto posture passes without exposing values

rollback.method: Restore only a captured exact allowlist for a proven consumer, through a separately reviewed migration.
rollback.runtime: Startup guard activation can be reverted independently; encryption and legacy-read values are never silently downgraded.
